title: Attempt records never name the subscription a claude-sub lease billed
body:
A dispatch's attempt record (.ticfac/runs/<run>/attempts/<n>.json) carries the executor, harness and model but not the claude-sub label the boot leased, though the boot knows it (sandbox-executor.ts:1788 carries claude_sub: {label, jobId}). An operator asking which subscription paid for which attempt — the question behind rotating or removing one, and behind any quota post-mortem — has no answer in the run's own records; today the rung is only inferable from the harness on the report's container-facts line, which says a lease was granted but not by whom. Recording the label on the attempt record would make that readable, and would make an A4-shaped acceptance item checkable directly instead of by inference.
evidence: .ticfac/runs/run_4d92bab25a7341d3bba01691779168a0/attempts/1.json against cloudflare/src/sandbox-executor.ts:1788
